issues: The additional cost is encoded incorrectly as optional and as engaging this card itself. It should be a required additional cost to engage a Levin follower on your field; encode it as a mandatory selectable engage cost targeting a self follower with the Levin trait. Implement engine support for required additional play costs and engage-cost target selection/filtering.

The Yurius condition is encoded incorrectly as namedFollowerOnFieldByName with identityName "Yurius", which checks exact name. It should check whether there is a follower on your field with "Yurius" in its name. Implement a condition for name-contains on a follower on your field, or a generalized field-name-substring condition.

The 3-damage target is encoded as enemyFieldCard, which can include amulets. It should target an enemy leader or enemy follower only; change to a selector/effect that allows enemyLeader or enemyFollower, not enemyFieldCard.

The activated effect is encoded as damageImmunity amount 4 to your leader, but the text is a damage cap/replacement effect for the rest of the turn: if your leader would take more than 4 damage, it takes 4 instead. Encode it as a temporary leader damage cap effect. Implement engine support for temporary leader damage-cap/replacement effects.

The hand-and-cemetery reset is encoded as handResetDraw, but the source says each player returns both hand and cemetery to their deck, shuffles, then draws 5 cards. Encode a full hand+cemetery reset to deck, shuffle, then fixed draw 5 for each player. Implement engine support for returning cemeteries to deck as part of a reset effect.

The final clause is encoded as passive playCostReduction on this card, but it should make the next card you play this turn cost 7 less. Change it to grantNextPlayCostReduction amount 7 without a restrictive filter.
The card has an incorrect keyword entry "evolve". Remove that keyword; the card only has an activated ability and evolve linkage fields.
The printed keyword/effect "Stack." is missing. Add the Stack keyword/effect to the encoding.

The fanfare condition is encoded incorrectly as fieldTraitMin trait "Amulet", but the text checks whether there's an amulet on your field, not a follower with trait Amulet. Change it to a condition that checks for at least 1 amulet on your field. Implement engine support for field card-type/count conditions such as having an amulet on your field.
